discovery_origin: Root proposed the historical upper-Gram test; Structural derived the new exact direction and full small-block classification. No different-author approval is asserted.
statement: For precisely the 17-point twelve-triangle edge unions in C-SEVENTEEN-POINT-LABELLED-TRIANGLE-FAMILY-FOUR-ISOMORPHISM-CLASSES r1, U=3I17-H+J17/9 has inertia (16,1,0) when PA=PB=PR, and is positive definite with inertia (17,0,0) for each of the other three named partition patterns. The first exact edgeunion therefore cannot occur as an induced principal subgraph of a (99,14,1,2) target; additional internal edges and completion of the other classes are not covered.
